summary: The minor is the five foundation courses (EPS 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6) and 9 units of breadth courses with a majority, at least 5 units, in EPS, for 27 units. Courses from outside the breadth list are moved in by hand, your advisor checks the 2.0 GPA, and transfer or test credit does not count. The Bulletin calls the foundation 18 units, but its five courses carry 17 in the catalog, so a minor with exactly 9 breadth units comes to 26 and needs one more unit toward the 27.

1BtReqiA.why: "Students must take a minimum of 9 additional units drawn primarily from the Breadth in the Discipline list in the EPS major; a majority of units must be from classes within the EPS department." A majority of 9 is at least 5, so at most 4 units come from other subjects. "Courses such as EPS 20, EPS 30N, EPS 38N, EPS 42, EPS 40N, and EPS 45 can contribute": EPS 38N, 40N and 45 are added (EPS 42 is not in the catalog; EPS 42N is already listed).

add.why: GPA: "Stanford undergraduates must maintain a minimum 2.0 cumulative GPA to remain in good academic standing and graduate."
